achievements.label: First Harvest
achievements.description: Clear a plot for the first time.

achievements.label: Second Chances
achievements.description: Replant a bare plot for the first time.

achievements.label: Full Recovery
achievements.description: A replanted plot fully recovers for the first time.

achievements.label: Standing Tall
achievements.description: Grow a single plot to full maturity without ever clearing it.

achievements.label: Old-Growth Grove
achievements.description: Have 5 plots reach full maturity at the same time.

achievements.label: Wildlife Returns
achievements.description: See a wildlife icon appear on a plot for the first time.

achievements.label: Biodiversity Haven
achievements.description: Have wildlife active on 10 plots at once.

achievements.label: Thriving Forest
achievements.description: Reach a combined biodiversity score of 25 across the forest.

achievements.label: Standing Fortune
achievements.description: Reach a standing forest value of 1,000.

achievements.label: Quick Money
achievements.description: Bank 1,000 in harvested income.

achievements.label: Balanced Ledger
achievements.description: Have at least 500 in both harvested income and standing forest value at the same time.

achievements.label: True Conservationist
achievements.description: Reach a standing forest value of 300 without ever clearing a single plot.

achievements.label: Resourceful Extractor
achievements.description: Clear plots 15 times total, across the whole forest.

achievements.label: Soil Scarred
achievements.description: Clear the same plot 5 times.

achievements.label: Community Ally
achievements.description: Reach maximum community relations (100).

achievements.label: Rebuilt Trust
achievements.description: Recover community relations back to 50 or higher after they dropped to 10 or lower.

achievements.label: Generous Host
achievements.description: Grant 10 stakeholder requests.

achievements.label: Principled Refusal
achievements.description: Decline 10 stakeholder requests.

achievements.label: Flourishing Canopy
achievements.description: Reach a standing forest value of 500 with every plot preserved or recovered — none bare or replanting.

achievements.label: Every Stage at Once
achievements.description: Have at least one plot in each of the four states — bare, replanting, preserved, and recovered — at the same time.

achievements.label: Second Growth
achievements.description: Unlock the Highland Grove, a second forest region.

achievements.label: Grove Keeper
achievements.description: Grow your forest into a Grove: reach a standing forest value of 2,500 (the second tier, after Seedling at 1,000).

achievements.label: Woodland Warden
achievements.description: Grow your forest into a Woodland: reach a standing forest value of 5,000.

achievements.label: Old-Growth Steward
achievements.description: Grow your forest into an Old-Growth forest: reach a standing forest value of 10,000.

achievements.label: Pacifist
achievements.description: Finish the Pacifist challenge: reach its standing-value goal without clearing a single plot.

achievements.label: Phoenix Forest
achievements.description: Finish the Scorched Start challenge: regrow a forest that began two thirds bare.

achievements.label: Sprinter
achievements.description: Finish the Sprint challenge: bank the income and hold the standing value inside 60 ticks.

achievements.label: Lowlander
achievements.description: Finish the No-Highland challenge with Highland Grove and Wetland Forest sealed.

achievements.label: Quick Payout
achievements.description: Clear-cut a plot for the first time: a bonus now, and soil that heals over about three seasons.

achievements.label: Harvester
achievements.description: Earn the Harvester playstyle badge (clears reach 0.6 per plot) with at least one clear-cut among them.
